import sys,json,gzip,hashlib,re,datetime,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import yaml
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ROOT=Path('/home/server/liufengrong/robot_lab')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'))
from policy_evaluation_evidence import validate_evaluation_bundle
from evidence_provenance import write_bytes,encode
TASK='RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0';RUN='2026-10-02_14-30-02';BATCH='overlap-native-model22000-20261003-004'
run=ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning'/TASK/RUN
rp=run/'evaluations'/BATCH/'raw/native-right15-noise-a01/result.json'
binding=validate_evaluation_bundle(rp)
result=json.loads(rp.read_bytes())
t=json.loads(gzip.decompress(Path(result['outputs']['telemetry']['path']).read_bytes()))
samples=t['samples'];dt=float(t['step_dt_seconds']);n=len(samples)
assert n==2000 and dt==.02 and t['telemetry_status']=='complete' and not t['missing_required_signals']
def arr(name):
 x=np.asarray([s[name] for s in samples],dtype=float)
 assert np.isfinite(x).all(),name
 return x
steps=np.asarray([s['step'] for s in samples]);assert np.array_equal(steps,np.arange(n))
cmd=arr('command');v=arr('root_linear_velocity_b');omega=arr('root_angular_velocity_b');pos=arr('root_position_w');q=arr('root_quaternion_w');jv=arr('joint_velocity');jp=arr('joint_position');a=arr('action');torque=arr('applied_torque')
env=yaml.load((ROOT/'logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa'/RUN/'params/env.yaml').read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
names=env['actions']['joint_pos']['joint_names']+env['actions']['joint_vel']['joint_names']
assert names[:2]==['right_hip_joint','left_hip_joint'] and env['actions']['joint_pos']['preserve_order']=='true'
hip_idx=[t['joint_names'].index(name) for name in names[:2]]
scale=np.array([.125,.125]);target=a[:,:2]*scale
assert [float(env['scene']['robot']['init_state']['joint_pos'][name]) for name in names[:2]]==[0.,0.]
hips_v=jv[:,hip_idx];hips_q=jp[:,hip_idx];hips_tau=torque[:,hip_idx]
qw,qx,qy,qz=q.T
yaw=np.unwrap(np.arctan2(2*(qw*qz+qx*qy),1-2*(qy*qy+qz*qz)))
student=arr('roa_student_velocity_b');true=arr('roa_true_velocity_b')
done=np.asarray([s['done'] for s in samples]);timeout=np.asarray([s['timeout'] for s in samples])
assert not done.any() and not timeout.any()
def rms(x):return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(x))))
def band(x,low=5.,high=25.):
 x=x-x.mean(axis=0)
 z=np.fft.rfft(x,axis=0);freq=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),dt)
 weights=np.full(len(freq),2.);weights[0]=1.
 if len(x)%2==0:weights[-1]=1.
 chosen=(freq>=low)&(freq<=high)
 per=np.sqrt(np.sum(np.abs(z[chosen])**2*weights[chosen,None],axis=0)/(len(x)**2))
 return {'rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(per**2))),'right_left':per.tolist()}
def window(lo,hi):
 assert 0<=lo<hi<=n
 sl=slice(lo,hi);c=cmd[sl];lin=v[sl];ang=omega[sl];pp=pos[sl,:2]
 return {'half_open_steps':[lo,hi],'sample_count':hi-lo,'nominal_duration_s':(hi-lo)*dt,'endpoint_time_span_s':(hi-lo-1)*dt,'command':c[0].tolist(),'mean_velocity_b_m_s':lin.mean(axis=0).tolist(),'mean_yaw_rate_b_rad_s':float(ang[:,2].mean()),'tracking_xy_rmse_m_s':rms(lin[:,:2]-c[:,:2])*math.sqrt(2),'tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s':rms(ang[:,2]-c[:,2]),'net_xy_displacement_m':float(np.linalg.norm(pp[-1]-pp[0])),'path_xy_length_m':float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pp,axis=0),axis=1).sum()),'world_heading_change_rad':float(yaw[hi-1]-yaw[lo]),'command_yaw_integral_rad':float(c[:-1,2].sum()*dt),'hip_target_step_rms_rad':rms(np.diff(target[sl],axis=0)),'hip_target_abs_peak_rad':float(np.abs(target[sl]).max()),'hip_target_rms_rad':rms(target[sl]),'hip_position_rms_rad':rms(hips_q[sl]),'hip_velocity_rms_rad_s':rms(hips_v[sl]),'hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz':band(hips_v[sl]),'hip_target_band_5_25Hz':band(target[sl]),'hip_position_band_5_25Hz':band(hips_q[sl]),'hip_torque_rms_Nm':rms(hips_tau[sl]),'hip_torque_abs_peak_Nm':float(np.abs(hips_tau[sl]).max()),'student_velocity_x_estimation_rmse_m_s':rms(student[sl,0]-true[sl,0]),'resets':int(done[sl].sum())}
windows={name:window(lo,hi) for name,lo,hi in [('initial_zero_steady',50,250),('forward_steady',300,750),('right_turn_steady',800,1500),('parking_steady',1550,2000),('parking_full_phase',1500,2000)]}
train_dir=run/'evidence/training'
health_paths=[train_dir/(BATCH+'-'+s+'.json') for s in ['before','during-01','during-02','during-03','during-04','during-05','after','recovery']]
health=[json.loads(p.read_bytes()) for p in health_paths]
progress=[x['tensorboard']['step'] for x in health]
assert all(x['process']['identity_matches'] for x in health) and all(b>a for a,b in zip(progress,progress[1:]))
begin=health[0]['tensorboard']['wall_time'];end=health[-2]['tensorboard']['wall_time']
fps={int(s['step']):s for h in health for s in h['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['samples']}
before_samples=[s['value'] for s in fps.values() if begin-60<=s['wall_time']<=begin]
during_samples=[s['value'] for s in fps.values() if begin<s['wall_time']<=end]
after_samples=[s['value'] for s in fps.values() if s['wall_time']>end]
throughput={'health_snapshots':[{'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in health_paths],'steps':progress,'all_monotonic':True,'same_training_identity':True,'before_last5_fps':health[0]['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['mean_last_5'],'minimum_overlap_snapshot_last5_fps':min(h['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['mean_last_5'] for h in health[1:-2]),'recovery_last5_fps':health[-1]['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['mean_last_5'],'before60s':{'count':len(before_samples),'mean_fps':float(np.mean(before_samples))},'overlap_all_between_pre_post_TB_times':{'count':len(during_samples),'mean_fps':float(np.mean(during_samples))},'post_until_recovery':{'count':len(after_samples),'mean_fps':float(np.mean(after_samples))},'all_loss_samples_finite':all(m['all_finite'] for h in health for tag,m in h['tensorboard']['metrics'].items() if tag.startswith('Loss/'))}
throughput['overlap_mean_drop_vs_before60s_percent']=(throughput['overlap_all_between_pre_post_TB_times']['mean_fps']/throughput['before60s']['mean_fps']-1)*100
out=run/'evidence/analysis/live-model22000-20261003-004';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
time_s=steps*dt
fig,axes=plt.subplots(4,1,figsize=(13,12),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True)
axes[0].plot(time_s,cmd[:,0],'k--',label='command vx');axes[0].plot(time_s,v[:,0],label='body vx');axes[0].plot(time_s,v[:,1],alpha=.5,label='body vy');axes[0].set_ylabel('Velocity (m/s)');axes[0].legend(ncol=3)
axes[1].plot(time_s,cmd[:,2],'k--',label='command yaw rate');axes[1].plot(time_s,omega[:,2],label='body yaw rate');axes[1].set_ylabel('Yaw rate (rad/s)');axes[1].legend()
for i,name in enumerate(['Right','Left']):axes[2].plot(time_s,target[:,i],alpha=.75,label=name+' requested target');axes[3].plot(time_s,hips_v[:,i],alpha=.75,label=name+' actual velocity')
axes[2].set_ylabel('Hip target (rad)');axes[2].legend(ncol=2);axes[3].set_ylabel('Hip velocity (rad/s)');axes[3].set_xlabel('Simulation time (s)');axes[3].legend(ncol=2)
for ax in axes:
 for transition in [5,15,30]:ax.axvline(transition,color='gray',lw=.8,alpha=.5)
 ax.grid(alpha=.2)
fig.suptitle('ROA Oct02 model22000 | Native 1 env | 15 ms delay | observation noise enabled')
timeline=out/'timeline.png';fig.savefig(timeline,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4),constrained_layout=True)
axes[0].plot(pos[:,0],pos[:,1]);axes[0].set(xlabel='World x (m)',ylabel='World y (m)',title='Measured world path');axes[0].axis('equal')
axes[1].plot(time_s,yaw,label='Measured world heading');axes[1].plot(time_s,np.cumsum(cmd[:,2])*dt,label='Command yaw-rate integral');axes[1].set(xlabel='Simulation time (s)',ylabel='Unwrapped angle (rad)',title='Heading; body yaw rate reported separately');axes[1].legend()
for ax in axes:ax.grid(alpha=.2)
path_plot=out/'path-heading.png';fig.savefig(path_plot,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4),constrained_layout=True)
ordered=sorted(fps.values(),key=lambda x:x['wall_time']);times=np.asarray([x['wall_time'] for x in ordered])-begin;rates=np.asarray([x['value'] for x in ordered]);ax.plot(times,rates/1000,lw=1)
ax.axvspan(0,end-begin,alpha=.2,color='orange',label='Pre/post evaluation TB interval')
ax.set(xlabel='Seconds from pre-evaluation TensorBoard time',ylabel='Training throughput (thousand steps/s)',title='Training continued; slowdown explicitly accepted');ax.legend();ax.grid(alpha=.2)
fps_plot=out/'training-throughput.png';fig.savefig(fps_plot,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
artifacts={k:{'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for k,p in [('timeline',timeline),('path_heading',path_plot),('training_throughput',fps_plot)]}
value={'version':1,'created_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'analysis_kind':'bounded_native_closed_loop_and_training_overlap','result_validation':binding,'windows':windows,'training':throughput,'telemetry_required_motion_signals_complete':True,'done_count':int(done.sum()),'sample_count':n,'analysis_source':{'python':ANALYSIS_SOURCE,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(ANALYSIS_SOURCE.encode()).hexdigest()},'artifacts':artifacts,'method':{'step_dt_s':dt,'steady_windows_exclude_first_1s_of_each_phase':True,'rms_xy_convention':'sqrt(mean(sum((vx,vy-command)^2,axis=1)))','hip_action_joint_order':names[:2],'hip_telemetry_indices':hip_idx,'hip_scale_rad_per_raw_action':scale.tolist(),'physical_target':'Policy-requested positions before the 15ms actuator buffer, hip default offset 0; not measured actuator setpoints','fft':'Demeaned rFFT; Parseval weights 2 except DC/Nyquist; rectangular window; band 5<=f<=25 Hz; differences stay inside each window','estimator_timing':'roa_student_velocity_b and roa_true_velocity_b are both captured before env.step; root velocities/joints are post-step','drift':'Euclidean world XY endpoint displacement; reported endpoint time is one dt shorter than sample-count duration; no reset crossing','training_fps':'Unique TB step samples, 60s before pre-snapshot TB time, between pre/post TB times, then until recovery; observational windows not controlled causality'},'limitations':['One seed and one environment, a mid-training fixed checkpoint; no convergence conclusion.','Four phases are shorter than historical 4500-step Native tests; static policy comparisons share identical archived inputs, Native protocols are not interchangeable.','No new hardware test; simulated tracking/parking and frozen-input sensitivity are separate evidence.'],'direct_parameter_change_supported':False}
write_bytes(out/'metrics.json',encode(value))
print(json.dumps({'metrics_path':str(out/'metrics.json'),'windows':windows,'training':throughput},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

limitations: One seed and one environment, a mid-training fixed checkpoint; no convergence conclusion.
Four phases are shorter than historical 4500-step Native tests; static policy comparisons share identical archived inputs, Native protocols are not interchangeable.
No new hardware test; simulated tracking/parking and frozen-input sensitivity are separate evidence.

method.drift: Euclidean world XY endpoint displacement; reported endpoint time is one dt shorter than sample-count duration; no reset crossing
method.estimator_timing: roa_student_velocity_b and roa_true_velocity_b are both captured before env.step; root velocities/joints are post-step
method.fft: Demeaned rFFT; Parseval weights 2 except DC/Nyquist; rectangular window; band 5<=f<=25 Hz; differences stay inside each window
method.physical_target: Policy-requested positions before the 15ms actuator buffer, hip default offset 0; not measured actuator setpoints
method.training_fps: Unique TB step samples, 60s before pre-snapshot TB time, between pre/post TB times, then until recovery; observational windows not controlled causality
